FX-THREADS-001.says: As added: threads 50 pixels apart, coverage 90, shadowing 50, centred on the drawing, so its middle falls between threads: the gap between two warp threads and the gap between two weft threads cross in the middle, columns 6 to 9 and rows 3 to 6 clear, half clear beside them; elsewhere the photo, the thread above hiding the one beneath, which shows shadowed only at the upper thread's soft edge.

FX-THREADS-002.says: Threads 4 pixels apart, unshadowed: a plain weave, each thread 3.6 pixels wide in the photo's colours, the edges of each pixel-wide gap between them soft.

FX-THREADS-003.says: FX-THREADS-002 at coverage 100: the threads meet edge to edge, their seams on pixel edges, so the photo shows whole, untouched.

FX-THREADS-004.says: FX-THREADS-002 at coverage 50: threads 2 pixels wide with 2-pixel gaps; where the gaps cross, clear.

FX-THREADS-006.says: FX-THREADS-002 with Overlaps 2: each thread over two and under two, a diagonal twill.

FX-THREADS-008.says: FX-THREADS-002 turned 30 degrees clockwise about the middle.

FX-THREADS-009.says: Shadowing 100: where the threads cross, the one beneath darkened, fully beside the one above, half where it is further off; the one above as in FX-THREADS-002.

FX-THREADS-010.says: Texture 100: each thread full in its middle and black at its edges, round.
